title: Sliding-Window Signatures as Features for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2510.12337v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The evolution of a time series is often influenced not only by its past values but also by external covariates, giving rise to forecasting with exogenous variables. Nonlinear and delayed effects between covariates and the target series make this task particularly challenging. We propose a forecasting framework based on Ridge regression with sliding-window signature features, combining the computational efficiency of (semi-)parametric models with the flexibility of nonparametric approaches. These features capture complex dependencies between the target and the exogenous variables without relying on prior assumptions about the form of these relationships or the influence of past observations. We establish theoretical guarantees in the discrete-time setting, including universality of approximation and stationarity for the sliding-window transform. translated_title: 滑动窗口签名特征用于时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 时间序列的演变不仅受其过去值的影响，还常常受到外部协变量的影响，由此产生了带外生变量的预测问题。协变量与目标序列之间的非线性及延迟效应使这一任务尤其具有挑战性。我们提出了一种基于岭回归并结合滑动窗口签名特征的预测框架，将（半）参数模型的计算效率与非参数方法的灵活性相结合。这些特征能够捕捉目标序列与外生变量之间的复杂依赖关系，而无需对这些关系的形式或过去观测的影响做先验假设。我们在离散时间设定下建立了理论保证，包括滑动窗口变换的逼近普适性与平稳性。为便于实现，我们引入了一种新颖的顺序算法，该算法利用了窗口……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于岭回归与滑动窗口签名特征的时间序列预测框架，能够无需先验假设地捕捉外生变量与目标序列之间的非线性延迟依赖关系，并给出了逼近普适性与平稳性的理论保证。
en_tdlr: A Ridge regression forecasting framework with sliding-window signature features is proposed, which captures nonlinear and delayed dependencies between exogenous variables and the target series without prior assumptions, and is supported by theoretical guarantees of approximation universality and stationarity.
